To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the implementation of PBF in Burkina Fasso was characterized by a lack of transparency, delays in setting up the agencies for performance monitoring and contracting, and delays in the payment of bonuses.
PBF implementation was slow in Burkina Fasso, and that the health care staff were using coping strategies in order to receive their bonuses.
the implementation of performance‐based financing was characterized by a gap between theory and practice, and that it was associated with a variety of coping strategies.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the implementation of a PBF programme and the strategies used by the health workers to cope with it.
the implementation of PBF in Burkina Fasso.
the implementation of a PBF intervention in Burkina Fasso and the way the intervention was received by the local actors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
PBF implementation in the health centres was not yet optimal 12 months post launch, but that the first audits led rapidly, in some cases, to coping strategies.
the PBF intervention in Burkina Fasso was implemented in an incomplete way and that it is too early to assess the impact of PBF.
PBF implementation was slow and that it was not yet clear whether PBF was being used as intended.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the implementation of PBF in Burkina Fasso has been a complex, dynamic and evolving process.
the PBF programme was launched in the health centres without sufficient prior preparation.
PBF is a complex public health intervention that needs to be implemented carefully and with attention to local contexts and actors.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the implementation of a complex intervention like PBF requires more than just a training of the health personnel and a change in payment system.
the PBF programme in Burkina Fasso is not yet well‐established.
, despite the fact that PBF was implemented in a very short timeframe, there were already signs that some actors were adapting the system to their needs, which may affect its effectiveness.
